svg.title: Eight FreeShip 26 features
svg.desc: Hull modeling: Subdivision control net, Edit and constrain geometry, Lackenby hull transformation; Shape inspection: Stations, buttocks, waterlines, Diagonals, curvature, normals, Model and face checks; Lines plan: From hull geometry, Automatic label placement, PNG and DXF export; Hydrostatics & stability: Hydrostatics and draft tables, KN and GZ curves, Bonjean and sectional areas; Resistance & propulsion: Holtrop, Delft and more, B-series open-water curves, Engine–propeller matching; Plate development: Unfold developable layers, Edge length and area errors, DXF and PDF export; File exchange: Read/write FBM, read FTM, IGES, DXF, STL and OBJ, GHS, PAM and more; Seven UI languages: 中文, English, Русский, Deutsch, Français, Español, 日本語
